blocks.text:
Discharge planning / TTOs
• TTO = to take out meds
• check meds are supplied + explained
• follow up appts / transport / family informed
• mobility safe? equipment needed?
• check discharge letter + paperwork
• confirm pt understands red flags / when to seek help

Safe discharge check Medically fit?
Meds ready?
Transport/home access sorted?
Patient/family understand plan?
Document discharge + handover before they leave ✓ ID band off ✓ valuables ✓ care plan updated ✓ DN meds returned if needed

Reflection:
Saw how delayed TTOs can hold everything up on the ward. Need to remember discharge planning starts early, not just when the patient is going home that day. I also need to ask more about support at home instead of assuming family can help.
